entries.title: Create validation rejects exactly-empty content but allows whitespace
entries.summary: validateCreateInput rejects content === '' with a ValidationError on field 'content' ('Content must be a non-empty string') but accepts whitespace-only content untrimmed. validateUpdateInput still accepts content ''.

entries.title: Note titles have no maximum length
entries.summary: validateCreateInput in src/utils/validation.ts accepts a note title of any length on create. It only checks that the title is a string whose trimmed form is non-empty; no maximum-length check exists.

demotions.note: At HEAD, src/utils/validation.ts:25-26 rejects content === '' in validateCreateInput with an error on field 'content'. The new test 'rejects empty content string' in tests/validation.test.ts passes, so the claim that create accepts '' is false.

At HEAD, validateCreateInput in src/utils/validation.ts has no MAX_TAGS constant and no tag-count check. The tags block only checks that tags is an array of strings, and grep finds no MAX_TAGS in src/ or tests/. Create does not reject 11+ tags, so the claimed create-only cap of 10 does not exist.
